Welcome.Title: Welcome to DDB Importer!
Welcome.FirstTime: It seems like you're using this module for the first time!
Welcome.Setup: DDB Importer requires some information before we can use it, chiefly linking it to your D&D Beyond account. Please take time to follow the documentation here. It's up to date and your best starting point.
Welcome.Later: You can always change these settings later under 'Configure Settings > Module Settings > DDB Importer!'
Welcome.Fin: Once setup is complete, you won't see this message again.

settings.add-extra-base-weapons.name: Add extra base weapons?
settings.add-extra-base-weapons.hint: After importing items, add new base weapons to the Foundry Base Weapon list?
settings.use-basic-rules.name: When parsing sources, add the D&D Basic Rules source rather than SRD or PHB 2024?
settings.use-basic-rules.hint: If unticked, the Importer will do its best to sort into the SRD 5.1 or PHB 2024 source instead. Please notes that this is a best guess as D&D Beyond does not have SRD Sources, but "Basic Rules" which cover a slightly different subset.
settings.disable-tattoo-type.name: Disable Spellwrought Tattoo
settings.disable-tattoo-type.hint: DDB Importer injects a tattoo consumable type and allows creation of Spellwrought tattoos.
settings.persistent-storage-location.name: Persistent Storage Location
settings.persistent-storage-location.hint: This is the location where DDB will cache DDB files like compendium backgrounds and DDB spell icons.
settings.munching-policy-force-spell-version.name: Monster Spell Version
settings.munching-policy-force-spell-version.hint: Determines if monsters should use 2024 spells or spell version that match their original rules
settings.user-hint-setting: If you are unaware of the purpose of a specific setting, it's recommended to leave it at the default value. Several of the settings rely on additional modules and are only recommended if you want to add that level of automation to your game.
settings.user-hint-effects: Several settings make mention of ActiveEffects. Please be aware that these are not animation effects.
settings.user-hint-animations: Please be aware that these are not animation effects.
settings.update-check.name: Check for available updates?
settings.log-level.name: Log Level
settings.log-level.hint: The level of console log statements that should be displayed in the console.

show-munch-top.name: Munch button be at the top?

settings.effects-uses-macro-status-effects.name: Use macro status effects?
settings.effects-uses-macro-status-effects.hint: If ticket will apply effects via DAE macro.StatusEffect method, rather than as a normal status effect. Defaults to off.
settings.custom-proxy.name: Use a custom proxy?
settings.custom-proxy.hint: Tick if using a custom proxy and enter the proxy URL's below
settings.image-upload-directory.name: Character image upload directory
settings.image-upload-directory.hint: Specifies the image upload location on the server.
settings.add-ddb-languages.name: Add D&D Beyond languages?
settings.add-ddb-languages.hint: If unticked DDB languages will be added to the custom field
settings.add-ddb-tools.name: Add D&D Beyond tool proficiencies?
settings.add-ddb-tools.hint: Registers tool proficiencies that D&D Beyond has but the dnd5e system does not, such as exotic instruments and custom tools. If unticked these are dropped on import.
settings.other-image-upload-directory.name: Other image upload directory
settings.other-image-upload-directory.hint: Specifies the image upload location on the server.
settings.frame-image-upload-directory.name: Image upload directory for frames
settings.frame-image-upload-directory.hint: Specifies the frame image upload location on the server.
settings.scene-upload-directory.name: Scene upload directory
settings.scene-upload-directory.hint: Specifies the scene upload location on the server.
settings.adventure-import-path.name: Adventure Import Path
settings.adventure-import-path.hint: Location where the module will look for adventure data files to import
settings.adventure-upload-path.name: Adventure Upload Path
settings.adventure-upload-path.hint: Location where the module will upload adventure images and data
settings.adventure-misc-path.name: Adventure Misc Upload Path
settings.adventure-misc-path.hint: Location where the module will upload misc adventure e.g. icons
settings.monster-link-title.name: Monster D&D Beyond link in title bar?
settings.monster-link-title.hint: Otherwise it's a button next to the name. (Reload to take effect).
settings.cobalt-cookie.name: DDB Cobalt Cookie
settings.cobalt-cookie.hint: You can get this using my Chrome extension https://github.com/MrPrimate/ddb-importer-chrome
settings.campaign-id.name: DDB Campaign URL or ID
settings.campaign-id.hint: Enter the campaign URL or ID, e.g. https://www.dndbeyond.com/campaigns/12345 or 12345
settings.spells-on-items-as-activities.name: Spells on Items As Activities
settings.spells-on-items-as-activities.hint: If checked spells on items will be created as activities, rather than usage linked from spells
settings.patreon-key.name: Patreon Supporter Key
settings.patreon-key.hint: Enter your Patreon Supporter Key here.
settings.auto-create-compendium.name: Auto create compendiums if not present?
settings.auto-create-compendium.hint: Auto create compendiums if not present?
settings.use-full-source.name: Use full source book name?
settings.show-resource-chooser-default.name: Show resource chooser default?
settings.show-resource-chooser-default.hint: On new characters should resource chooser be enabled by default?
settings.monster-has-vision.name: Should imported monster have vision set?
settings.monster-has-vision.hint: If unticked monsters will not have vision set
settings.restrict-to-trusted.name: Restrict to Trusted Users
settings.restrict-to-trusted.hint: Restrict character import to Trusted Users
settings.allow-all-sync.name: Allow all users to sync to DDB
settings.allow-all-sync.hint: If character import is restricted, this option will still allow players to sync back to DDB.
settings.apply-conditions-with-ce.name: Convenient Effect Conditions?
settings.apply-conditions-with-ce.hint: If Convenient Effects is installed, use it to manage conditions
settings.use-loose-srd-reference-matching.name: Loose Rules referencing?
settings.use-loose-srd-reference-matching.hint: Attempt to match any references to SRD rules, may result in some false positives
settings.setup.name: Core setup
settings.compendium-setup.name: Compendiums
settings.folder-setup.name: Directory Locations
settings.folder-setup.hint: Chose the folders/directories to store images
settings.dynamic-update-setup.name: Dynamic DDB Update Setup
settings.dynamic-update-setup.hint: Push character updates straight back to D&D Beyond!
settings.character-link-title.name: Character DDB-Importer button in title bar?
settings.character-link-title.hint: Otherwise it's a button next to the name. (Reload to take effect).
settings.link-title-colour-white.name: Make title bar icon white?
settings.link-title-colour-white.hint: Default is Red. Reload to take effect.
settings.use-damage-hints.name: Use damage type hints?
settings.use-damage-hints.hint: When building damage strings e.g. 1d6[healing]. Useful for MidiQOL etc.
settings.add-damage-restrictions-to-hints.name: Add restrictions to damage hint?
settings.add-damage-restrictions-to-hints.hint: If a damage restriction is in place, add this to the damage hint
settings.natural-twenty-damage-as-critical.name: Natural 20 item damage as critical damage?
settings.natural-twenty-damage-as-critical.hint: Item damage that D&D Beyond only grants when you roll a 20 on the attack (e.g. Life Stealing, Titan's Tooth) is added to the attack's critical damage, so it rolls with the critical hit. Foundry cannot tell a natural 20 from other critical hits, so it also applies on expanded critical ranges and automatic critical hits. Turn off to get a separate damage roll for it instead, to use after rolling a 20. Applies to items imported after the change.
settings.allow-scene-download.name: Allow Download of Scene Data
settings.allow-scene-download.hint: If you wish to submit data for walls and lighting of a scene use this option to download a config file for submission.
settings.top-level-compendium-folder.name: Top level compendium folder?
settings.top-level-compendium-folder.hint: If selected will place compendiums into a folder called D&D Beyond (v11 only)
settings.munching-selection-compendium-folders-mo: If using compendium folders, what kind of folders do you want the muncher to create?
settings.munching-selection-compendium-folders-sp: If using compendium folders, what kind of folders do you want the muncher to create?
settings.munching-selection-compendium-folders-it: If using compendium folders, what kind of folders do you want the muncher to create?

embed-macros.name: Embed macros in items?
embed-macros.hint: Embed macros into items? If not selected, item macro will call DDB Importer to generate and run the appropriate macro on the fly. Advantages: don't need to remunch spells to get macro, less data stored in world. Disadvantages: harder to debug, need to be running DDB Importer.

no-item-macros.name: Remove macros from items?
no-item-macros.hint: If selected will call DDB Functions for Midi-QOL and DAE to run macros, supersedes embed macros option.

settings.show-image-to-players.name: Show the show image to players button?
settings.show-image-to-players.hint: In journals provide hover-over button to show image to players? (Reload required)
settings.show-read-alouds-button.name: Show the show read aloud to players button?
settings.show-read-alouds-button.hint: In journals provide hover-over button to show the read aloud to players? (Reload required)
settings.show-read-alouds-all-content.name: Enable read aloud for all content?
settings.show-read-alouds-all-content.hint: Show the read aloud to player button in content not imported by DDB Importer as well. (Reload required)
settings.show-welcome-message.name: Show Welcome Message?
settings.show-welcome-message.hint: If checked the welcome message will be shown on next login.

compendium-mapping.Title: DDB Importer Compendium Settings
compendium-mapping.Intro: Some DDB Importer compendium settings point at the same compendium, so imported content of different kinds would be mixed together. Choose a separate compendium for each, or create the missing DDB compendiums. Settings can be left as None.
compendium-mapping.NoDefault: Its DDB compendium does not exist yet.
compendium-mapping.NothingMissing: Every clashing setting already has its DDB compendium; choose one for each setting instead.
compendium-mapping.Remapped: DDB Importer: compendium settings for {list} shared a compendium with another setting and were pointed back at their own DDB compendiums.
compendium-mapping.CreateFailed: DDB Importer: unable to create the missing compendiums, see the console for details.
compendium-mapping.DuplicateSave: A compendium can only be used for one setting. These settings share one: {list}. Nothing was saved.
